name: Lean-Away Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on next to a sturdy post or rack, with your feet near its base. Hold the post at about chest height with your near hand.
Hold a dumbbell in your far hand and lean away from the post until your arm on the post is straight. Let the dumbbell hang in front of your hip.
Keep your body still and your working elbow a little bent. Raise the dumbbell out to the side until your arm is level with your shoulder. Do not shrug.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to the start position. Do all the repetitions, then change sides.
